exposure: Maternal position during induction of combined spinal-epidural anesthesia (CSEA) with hypobaric ropivacaine (sitting, left-lateral, or right-lateral)
outcome: Incidence and total dose of phenylephrine supplement
Neonatal Apgar scores at 1 min and 5 min
pH values of umbilical arterial and venous blood
cohort: The study included 88 American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status I and II parturients undergoing elective cesarean section.
finding: CSEA with hypobaric ropivacaine in the sitting position significantly increased the incidence of hypotension and resulted in a higher block level compared to lateral positions.
